slides.title: Why does the company do what it does?
slides.support: Each leader answers all three alone. Share one question at a time, starting with What. Then read your Core Purpose aloud. Does your Why match it?

artwork.alt: Three rings run from Why at the center through How to What. Each ring has its own question: why, how and what does the company do.

notes: Once a year, test the Core Purpose with the Golden Circle. What the company does and how it does it are easy. Why is where drift shows up.
Each leader writes their answers alone. Then the team shares one by one, question by question, starting with What.
Only then read the Core Purpose aloud from the One Page Plan. Compare it with the team’s Why.
If the team’s Why no longer matches the Core Purpose, that is not a failure. It is a signal the foundation needs attention.
The discussion creates a new Core Purpose, adjusts the current one or confirms it. A purpose that describes what the company does, not why, needs work.
The agreed Core Purpose goes into the top circle when the team tests its BHAG.
